evidence: Walked every scored and gate criterion against the frozen reference. No criterion was found that the golden cannot satisfy. SEEDED FIGURES: seed_data.json gives Platform Engineer Applied Greta Lindqvist(1), Ade Bello(2), Marco Rossi(3) and Screen Priya Nair(1), Samuel Ortiz(2), matching hro_restart/protocol Z. Noor's APP-101 note is 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' (matches Z). APP-101 has 120 messages (matches app_context). Lena's read_count of 2 of 3 gives 1 unread (computed from the seed, matching hro_unread_counts). thread_page_size=30 and the candidate_status_labels match hro_candidate_view wording exactly. db.js:182-200 seeds once (users count guard), so hro_restart is satisfiable. GATES: login 401 on bad password (index.js:87). Open job and add candidate are server-backed and an Observer context sees them via /api/bootstrap. BOARD RULES (index.js checkMove 238-265, moveCards 274-321): one-stage-only (409), reject needs a reason (400) and is refused from Hired (409), reopen only to rejected_from (409), Interview limit counted for the whole set (294), bulk sorted by board order (284-288: STAGES index*100000+position, giving Y,W,X and A2,V as the criteria require), and the transaction is all-or-nothing. A stale version gives a 409 whose text includes the last activity detail (' moved F from Screen to Applied'), which identifies who (hro_stale_refused). Undo (348-373) is own-latest-only and single-use, is refused if any card's version changed (reorder/reject/move bump version, notes do not), is refused on Interview overfill, and restores stage, index, rejected_from and reject_reason (hro_reopen, hro_undo_restores, hro_undo_conflict, hro_undo_once, hro_undo_full). ROLES/STATUS: hiring-manager limits are at 257-264. Observer gets 403 (mayMove, auth('recruiter','hiring_manager') on undo, staffOnly on notes). Candidate gets 404 for apps not theirs and 403 otherwise. Anonymous gets 401 via auth() on every data route. Ingrid's and the Observer's send gets 403 and Noor's gets 404 (application() 121-131), satisfying hro_refusal_status. ACTIVITY: per-card lines for open, add, move, reject (with reason), reopen, reorder and undo (log/describe 195-271), newest first (ORDER BY id DESC), job filter in app.js:65, Observer reads the same bootstrap. Refused actions roll back, so they add no line. JOB VALIDATION: blank title, 0, 51 and the recruiter-as-manager replay are refused server-side (202-207). The UI's 2.5 goes through regex to NaN, JSON null, then a refusal. EMAIL: lowercased duplicate/invalid errors carry field:'candidate_email', and board.js:53 shows them at the field without clearing the inputs. UI: Move select plus Up/Down are ordinary controls. The move appears at once and is put back, with focus on the card's select, on refusal (board.js:181-205, hro_refused_put_back). Live updates use an SSE 'changed' event (index.js:48-53) and an in-place keyed patch that preserves open details, the note draft, focus and scroll (hro_live_board, hro_pol_live_board). CONVERSATIONS: latest 30 open, scrolled to newest. 'Show earlier messages (N more)' keeps place via scrollTop delta (threads.js:160-175). Messages render as textContent with .body white-space:pre-wrap (plain literal, line breaks kept). Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a newline, and after sending the box is empty and focused. Arrival while scrolled up shows a 'N new messages' pill and leaves the message unread (catchUp 145-159). A seen boundary that excludes the Observer counts recruiters and the job's own manager (index.js:143-150). Drafts and note drafts are keyed by user id plus conversation/card in localStorage (app.js:39-43), so they survive switching and reloads, Mei sees none, and Rafael's return restores them. A 401 mid-draft triggers sessionLost(), which prompts sign-in without sending (hro_pol_session_resume). A send aborted by the network gives status 0 and 'Not sent...' with the text kept (hro_pol_failed_send). Candidate bootstrap returns only id, job_title, team, status wording and thread summary; the SSE payload is the literal '1' (hro_candidate_private). RUNTIME: the raw-evidence-index hashes match the frozen solution bytes. workspace.json records 25 scripted golden groups, all passed with no page errors, including stale-move naming, bulk/undo through the page, live board (804 ms arrival) keeping the card, note draft and focus, earlier-page place via getBoundingClientRect, plain plain text, unread and seen updates, ended-session resume and a real restart. CONFORMING-ALTERNATIVE/BROKEN-APP PROBE (within this row): the golden momentarily shows a count of 1 on an open-at-newest conversation (the bootstrap is computed before the client's markRead POST, app.js render then threads.js catchUp). Protocol U reads at or after 15 s, so this transient does not fail hro_unread_counts, but a judge that snapshots immediately could misread it. Reorder Activity lines say ' reordered in ' without the new place; hro_activity's '(the stages for moves)' wording accepts that. Visual likert rows depend on judge taste; the styled screenshots exist but no judge scored them.
notes: Pass covers plausibility only. risk=true because no full configured judge run, Oracle grade or judge-duration measurement exists (the raw-evidence-index scope says so explicitly). The scripted golden driver does not walk every criterion as the judge would. Not exercised by script: the polish failed-send row (route abort of a send), the job-open refusal legs (blank, 0, 51, 2.5, recruiter-as-manager), the full Activity filter/attribution walk over protocols S..V, hro_seen's Bill-opens leg on Tomas's page through the candidate UI (only the API group 'hiring manager ... marks the candidate message seen' exists), and the visual likert rows. These were source-verified only. The very long functional protocol (41 criteria, 14 protocols, 9000 s judge timeout) means the Oracle could still lose points to judge budget or tool limits, which this source review cannot rule out. This row does not claim an Oracle, model or portal score.
